functions.name: Lex
functions.docs:
An expression parser, responsible for lexing, compiling, and evaluating expressions.
The parser supports 3 functions:
1. Lexing the expression into a set of user defined tokens,
2. Compiling the tokenized expression to an efficient reverse-polish execution order,
3. Evaluating the compiled tokens
See ExpressionParserExamples.cpp for example usage.

functions.name: Compile
functions.signature: Compile(In Expression, Token Definitions, In Grammar)
functions.docs: Compile the specified expression into an array of Reverse-Polish order nodes for evaluation, according to our grammar definition

functions.name: Compile
functions.docs: Compile the specified tokens into an array of Reverse-Polish order nodes for evaluation, according to our grammar definition

functions.name: Evaluate
functions.signature: Evaluate(In Expression, In Token Definitions, In Grammar, In Environment)
functions.docs: Evaluate the specified expression using the specified token definitions, grammar definition, and evaluation environment

functions.name: Evaluate
functions.docs: Evaluate the specified pre-compiled tokens using an evaluation environment
